title: Sanity
summary: SAN'ITY, noun [Latin sanitas. See Sane.] Soundness; particularly, a sound state of mind; the state of a mind in the perfect exercise of reason.

inlines.v: SAN'ITY, noun [Latin sanitas. See Sane.] Soundness; particularly, a sound state of mind; the state of a mind in the perfect exercise of reason.
